0022600181.text: The Houston Rockets (7-1, first in the Southwest and the West) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (5-3, third in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, seventh in the West) with Houston riding a two-game winning streak and a 4-0 home record. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Rockets lost the 2025-26 series 1-2, including a 136-132 defeat in their last meeting on April 10, 2026.
